about: The latest videos on YouTube for the site's FULL HISTORY VIDEOS menu, one for each weighting and colouring: usd-age and btc-age, each bar as its share of the day's realized cap and of all the coins, stacked in age bands (VIDEO (% USD-AGE), VIDEO (% BTC-AGE)), and usd-lthsth and btc-lthsth, split into short- and long-term holders (VIDEO (% USD-LTH/STH), VIDEO (% BTC-LTH/STH)). Written by .github/workflows/video.yml once an upload is viewable (unlisted or public); null until then.
